OverviewThe C850 SFX Gold is an efficient, compact solution built for your small form factor (SFF) setup. It’s fully ATX 3.1 compliant and includes a 600W 12V-2x6 connector, ensuring steady performance for demanding graphics cards. Experience stable, quiet, and cool power delivery, all within a tiny footprint.
Designed for Compact Builds: Maximize your space efficiency with the SFX form factor, delivering full power capabilities in a size optimized for small form factor (SFF) cases.
Reliable GPU Power: ATX 3.1 certification and a 600W 12V-2x6 connector ensure safe, dependable power delivery for modern graphics cards.
Premium Efficiency, Quiet Operation: 80 PLUS Gold & Cybenetics Platinum efficiency ratings mean less heat is generated, while Cybenetics A- noise rating ensures a quieter overall system.
Uninterrupted System Performance: Low ripple noise, tight voltage regulation, and long hold-up time help protect your components and keep your system running smoothly.
Silent Cooling with FDB Fan: A 92 mm fluid dynamic bearing (FDB) fan offers durable and efficient cooling, featuring a Zero RPM mode for silent operation.
Enhanced Durability and Stability: Constructed with 105°C-rated Japanese capacitors, guaranteeing long-term reliability and stable performance especially during heavy workloads.
Simplify Cable Management: Fully modular design with embossed cables and included combs allows you to connect only the essentials, improving routing in tight builds.
Built for Safety and Longevity: A full suite of safety protections and rigorous stress testing help safeguard your PC, all backed by a 10-year warranty for long-term peace of mind.
Power, Perfectly Compact
Experience focused power in minimal spaces with the C850 SFX Gold, delivering 80 PLUS Gold efficiency and ATX 3.1 reliability. Designed specifically for small yet powerful builds, it is the essential, capable core of your system.
Made For Smaller CasesThe SFX form factor slides easily into the smallest cases, offering dependable, high-output power without taking up unnecessary room.Ready for Great BuildsWith ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 support, power is prepared for today and the future. Includes a 600W 12V-2x6 cable to reliably power demanding graphics cards.
Efficient Power Delivery80 PLUS Gold certification and Cybenetics Platinum rating mean less wasted energy and cooler operation. Efficient power is smart power.
Premium Japanese CapacitorsBuilt with 100% Japanese capacitors rated to 105°C for consistent, long-term performance and reliability that lasts for years.Simple, Clean ConnectionsFully modular, embossed all-copper cables let you connect only what you need, while included PSU cable combs keep runs clean, aligned, and organized.Whisper-Quiet CoolingA 92 mm fluid dynamic bearing fan with Zero RPM mode and A- Cybenetics noise rating keeps cooling near-silent and consistent under any load. Safe, Stable, SecureBuild and use with confidence. A full set of safety features ensures performance is reliable and worry-free. Everything is protected by a 10-year warranty.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use an SFX PSU in a regular ATX case?
Yes, but be mindful of the cable lengths. We include all the connections required for a high performance build but optimized for a Small Form Factor (SFF) / mini-ITX build. We do not include a SFX to ATX bracket.
Is the C850 SFX compatible with the latest GPUs and CPUs?
Yes. The C850 SFX is ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 compliant, making it ready for the latest GPUs with the 12V-2x6 connector. It also includes PCIe cables for older graphics cards, as well as all the standard connectors needed for current AMD and Intel CPUs.
